item.title: NBA 2K25 Sounds The Buzzer On Its Best Game Modes, With A Delist & Server Shutdown Inbound

description.p: MyCareer and MyTeam hit the bench.We NBA 2K fans are no strangers to an online server shutdown, but 2K is pushing the boat out even further this year, as it has announced that NBA 2K25 is being fully delisted later this month, with the ensuing server closings pruning the title's two best game modes (thanks for the heads up, VGC).The publisher recently took to the 2K25 Steam page to announce that the game will be removed from online storefronts on 30th October 2026, with all online content shutting up shop on 31st December. Those who already own the 2024 edition will be able to redownload it after the October cutoff, but all online modes will be gone for good as of January 2027.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Free-To-Play RPG 'The New Denpa Men' Is Ending Service Later This Year

description.p: Denparessing.Genius Sonority, the developer and publisher behind the 2024 free-to-play RPG The New Denpa Men, has announced that it is wrapping up the game's service later this year.The game's regular service will end on 7th December at 8pm GMT / 9pm CET / 12pm PT / 3pm ET, with all in-game data such as Jewels and items no longer being available — the studio recommends you use any paid Jewels before things come to a close, though it sounds like some refunds will be available.Read the full article on nintendolife.com
